feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 15 November 2026 11:30am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 15 November 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Area of low pressure to the southwest, tracking southeast and driving frontal systems across the area.


##Wind##

Cyclonic 3 to 5, becoming northwest 5 to 7 through the afternoon, decreasing 4 or 5 overnight, then 3 or 4 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate occasionally rough for a time this evening, falling slight tomorrow morning


##Weather##

Rain at first, clearing to isolated showers through the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 3 or 4, becoming east or southeast 4 or 5 tomorrow afternoon, increasing 6 to gale 8 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming smooth or slight, building slight or moderate in the evening, then moderate or rough overnight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally poor later.
